Support RTD

Copy & give original to Mary Ann

To whom it may concern,

I'm writing to let you know my husband and I have been smoking Doral Light for the last five years. We both smoke, and in my opinion, people smoke on their own and it's their choice. It's not the fault of any cigarette company. So, I believe no one should be blamed but themselves.

I started smoking at 15 years old, although I tried puffing on them from 13 or 14. Yes, Sailor's Light was my next choice. I only smoke Doral Lights and Marlboro, which I like. Being honest, we do smoke right now. We are both of legal age and aware of it.
